$comment: Scoped record of lane A (PhoneUse-derived device reservations and durable action outcomes). Fixture and loopback evidence only; nothing here was run on, or qualifies, a physical device.
model: claude-opus-5-5 (workspace-local .claude settings, Bash sandbox enabled with failIfUnavailable)

commits.record: the commit that adds this file

upstream_reference.note: Patterns only (TTL-bounded client reservation checked at queue admission and before input; request identity committed before dispatch, conflicts on changed arguments, no automatic replay across transports). The implementation is original Tomacco Rust; no upstream code, installer, test or prompt was run.

reservations.canonical_device: platform/scope/device (scope local or remote:NAME); a runtime session ID resolves to the device it shows, virtual-iphone to ios/local/virtual-iphone, a device.label nickname to its serial or UDID offline; an emulator nickname is refused (only adb knows its serial)
reservations.capability: reservation_token = tmres_ + 64 hex digits (two UUIDv4), answered only by acquire and takeover with acquire; stored as SHA-256 only; masked by redact (key reservation_token and the tmres_ pattern) in audit, errors, job records and session logs
reservations.labels: owner (required), task, reason are caller labels; client and channel are what the caller reported (MCP clientInfo, TOMACCO_CLIENT, desktop); none is authentication
reservations.ttl: 1000..300000 ms, default 60000; renew extends a reservation that still holds; an ended one cannot be revived
reservations.admission: each input is admitted inside one SQLite IMMEDIATE transaction right before its transport; discrete inputs are recorded in flight while they run (bound 120 s, PID+start-time liveness), a touch from down to up (bound 60 s); acquire waits up to wait_ms (default 2000, max 30000) for others' admitted inputs, else device_input_in_flight; exactly one of concurrent acquisitions wins
reservations.early_check: coordination::participate does the same check read-only before a participating call prepares or queues anything, so a refusal there sent nothing
reservations.human_control: device.reservation.takeover (destructiveHint true, reason required, optional acquire) is the explicit path; the previous holder's queued inputs then answer reservation_revoked with the reason; touch cancel is always admitted so no finger stays down
reservations.restart_and_crash: reservations belong to the device, not the session: they survive runtime.stop/start and worker restarts; admissions of dead processes and over-long touches are purged; a token of a reservation lost (other data directory, power cut in WAL synchronous=NORMAL) answers reservation_not_held

request_ledger.participating_arguments: request_id (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{0,127}$) and reservation_token on runtime.input, runtime.gesture, runtime.actions, screen.tap, android.input, testing.action, ios.emulator.control (input actions only)
request_ledger.before_dispatch: the executing process commits id, operation, SHA-256 of the canonical arguments (session, device, token, identity, width/height removed; device compared as its canonical key), route, transport, instance (pid:PID:START or session:ID:pid:...), state pending; synchronous=FULL
request_ledger.children: the runtime worker records each input it delivers under ID/N or ID/step-N with itself as executor, before the device gets it, and never runs one child identity twice
request_ledger.repeat: same intent -> recorded outcome with request.retained true, replayed false; other operation/device/arguments -> request_conflict; pending with a live executor -> request_in_progress; executor gone or answer lost -> unknown and request_outcome_unknown, never resent through the same or another session/transport; a single-input request whose caller died is settled from its worker child's record
request_ledger.statuses: applied (transport took it), verified (batch whose steps' expect held), refused (provably nothing dispatched; may be repeated under the same id), failed (ran and errored; its error says what reached the device), unknown
request_ledger.privacy: no typed text (summary counts characters, stored answers replace text/value by length and are redacted), no token
request_ledger.bounds: 24 h retention, at most 20000 rows, stored answer at most 64 KiB (else a truncated summary); owner-only files in TOMACCO_HOME/coordination
request_ledger.cost: a call without request_id writes nothing to the ledger; per-frame video and pointer moves are never recorded

capabilities.not_exactly_once: A transport that loses an answer leaves the effect unknown; the ledger only prevents Tomacco from resending and tells the agent to observe.

participating.route: runtime worker device loop (native/runtime.rs worker -> coordination::worker_input)

operations: ios.virtual.unlock and the startup unlock (refused while another holder has it; no token argument)

not_participating.what: device mutations that are not input: device.install, device.app, android.launch, android.deep_link, android.settings, android.permission, android.display, android.environment.apply/restore, ios.virtual.* lifecycle, ios.emulator.control stop/trust_cache_update
not_participating.why: not part of this lane's input contract; each would need its own admission kind and semantics (installs and lifecycle run as jobs)
they honour a reservation (refused when another holds the device) but take no reservation_token argument yet

not_participating.what: raw adb, SSH, fastboot, flashing tools, other agents, the MacBook installer
not_participating.why: outside Tomacco's process boundary; integration protocol documented in docs/agents.md (acquire before acting, renew while working, release after, read device.reservation.get before a raw step); no Harness or deployment agent is integrated

blockers.detail: test_i18n requires every operation title in qml/OperationTitles.js, finished in all complete catalogs. This lane was told not to add QML/UI strings; the user was asked (Harness task.ask, no answer within its 30-minute bound) and the recommended option was taken: no UI strings here. The desktop falls back to the English title for these 8 operations meanwhile. The integration task should add the 8 titles (and any new titles of lane B) and translate them once for all 51 catalogs, then the check is green.
No physical qualification: the Pixel is in use and unreleased; every result here is fixture evidence.

integration_notes: Operation counts (296 operations, 108 read-only, 29 destructive) in README.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/agent-patterns.md (count and destructive list), docs/agent-clients.md, SKILL.md, the README graphics (assets/readme/generate.py), docs/reference and the skill references (tools/build_reference.py) and docs/mobile-parity (tools/build_mobile_parity.py) must be recomputed after merging lane B's operations.

assets/operations.json: lane B may add properties to runtime.input/runtime.actions/screen.* or new operations; this lane appended reservation_token and request_id as the last two properties of 7 operations and one sentence to their descriptions, and inserted 8 operations after device.resolve.

native/runtime/actions.rs: this lane only made check/mutates pub(crate) and wrapped run_step with set_label; a new verified-fill step in lane B must keep sending its input through runtime::request (or screen::tap) so the worker admits and records it.
native/runtime/iphone.rs field read-back (lane B) runs inside the worker's device.input and is admitted as one input; reads (context, hierarchy) are never admitted or recorded.

ledger::REFUSED lists error codes that prove nothing was dispatched; new pre-send refusal codes from lane B (for example a field-not-focused or editor-mismatch refusal) should be added there so they stay retryable under the same request_id.
